source_files_inspected: scout/api.py (routes, middleware, seed/directive handlers; remainder is embedded dashboard HTML)
languages_frameworks: single-file embedded dashboard (Vis.js style) in scout/api.py

implemented_capabilities.capability: Multi-hop blast radius from an asset through employees, projects and documents with a heuristic risk score
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real parameterised OPTIONAL MATCH/collect Cypher (REPORTS_TO*1..3, [*1..3] undirected path audit), but the risk score is a hand-weighted linear formula (employees*10 + projects*25 + documents*20 + tier bonus) with arbitrary thresholds, not an algorithm.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Incident investigation 'agent' (hop trace, tool choice, auto-quarantine)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Despite the docstring about dynamic tool selection there is no LLM or planner: concept is chosen by keyword match on the incident title, TOOL-02 FirewallQuarantine is hard-coded for any High/Critical severity, and log suspiciousness is a keyword list. Quarantine is executed autonomously with no approval gate; it only mutates graph properties (status, QUARANTINED_BY edge).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Graph agent memory (sessions, interactions, concepts, procedural recall, agent handoff edges)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Straightforward episodic/semantic memory over Session, Interaction, Concept and Agent nodes with RECORDED_IN, RECALLS, USED_TOOL, HANDED_OFF_TO edges and ISO timestamps; recall is substring/lowercase match, not embedding similarity.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Incident evidence export bundle with SHA-256 integrity checksum
implemented_capabilities.notes: Compiles incident, logs, blast radius and precedents into a JSON/Markdown bundle with a plain SHA-256 checksum (no signature or key, so it only detects accidental change). Hard-codes the recalled concept in the same way as the agent.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Operator directive endpoint with simulated dual-agent reply
implemented_capabilities.notes: Returns canned strings and fixed latency badges ('14ms', '18ms') and claims a Cypher traversal and a SEC-402 compliance check that are never executed.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Synthetic attack simulator and tactical audio script generator
implemented_capabilities.notes: Four scripted attack scenarios and template-string voice cues over hard-coded seed data (10 employees, 3 teams, 2 projects, 3 assets); not an analytic capability.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Stdio MCP-style server exposing five tools
implemented_capabilities.notes: Hand-written JSON-RPC loop supporting only tools/list and tools/call (no initialize handshake, so strict MCP clients may fail); exposes scout_quarantine_asset as a write tool with no approval step.

graph_models_and_cypher: Nodes: Employee, Team, Project, Asset {tier, status, ip}, Document, Agent, Session, Interaction, Concept, Incident {severity,status}, Tool, Log. Edges: REPORTS_TO, MEMBER_OF, ASSIGNED_TO, ACCESSED, CONTAINS, AFFECTS, TRIGGERED_BY, INVESTIGATED, USED_TOOL, QUARANTINED_BY, HAS_SESSION, RECORDED_IN, RECALLS, HANDED_OFF_TO. Query values are parameterised, but scout/db.py builds labels, relationship types and the visualisation LIMIT by f-string (create_node/get_node/update_node/create_edge/get_graph_visualization). Indexes created per label on id. Uses MERGE ... SET n += $props upserts. No APOC/GDS or FalkorDB algo.* calls.
algorithms: Hand-weighted linear risk score with fixed severity thresholds (scout/brain.py)
Keyword-matching incident triage and fixed severity-to-tool policy (scout/agent.py)
Substring concept recall over graph memory (scout/memory.py)
SHA-256 integrity checksum on export bundle (scout/exporter.py)
backend_interfaces: Stdio JSON-RPC MCP-like server (scout/mcp_server.py) with 5 tools
frontend_interfaces: Large inline HTML/JS dashboard served from scout/api.py (3-panel graph, incident feed, directive console, tactical audio via browser speech)
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Graph-persisted sessions/interactions/concepts with procedural recall of tools used per concept and HANDED_OFF_TO edges for multi-agent handoff (audit edges only; no second agent actually runs). Investigation results are written back as an Interaction linked to a Concept. No LLM is involved anywhere in the code read.
tests_present: tests/test_scout.py: 9 pytest tests against the (embedded) graph; scripts/benchmark.py for latency. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: scout/api.py:29-35 - CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True and all methods/headers
scout/api.py:141-145 - unauthenticated POST /api/seed deletes and rebuilds the whole graph
scout/api.py:180-190, scout/mcp_server.py:~70 - unauthenticated and unapproved write actions (investigate triggers quarantine; scout_quarantine_asset MCP tool)

scout/db.py:55-100 and 120-130 - f-string interpolation of node label, relationship type and visualisation LIMIT into Cypher (create_node, get_node, update_node, create_edge, get_graph_visualization); values are parameterised but label/rel names are caller-supplied in principle (currently only fixed internal strings)
scout/api.py:~190 - /api/agent/directive reflects user text into a response claiming verified compliance checks that never ran (integrity/misrepresentation concern)
scout/exporter.py:~75 - integrity_checksum is an unkeyed SHA-256, offering no tamper-evidence against an attacker who can rewrite both bundle and checksum
No eval/exec/subprocess/pickle; .env.example holds empty values; no hard-coded secrets found
duplicates_or_overlaps: Company-brain blast radius and incident triage overlap kalp-cg/graph-hacks and other SOC/RCA repos; graph agent memory overlaps other Agent Memory & Provenance repos but is simpler than them.
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - timestamps on quarantine edges and a checksummed evidence export give minimal audit trail, but there is no provenance chain, supersession, temporal validity, dependency invalidation or approval gating (the quarantine is autonomous).

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, readable graph schema for sessions, interactions, concepts and handoffs that could seed an Agent Memory pack; the rest is scripted demo logic.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (or embedded falkordblite); no LLM needed

strategy_rationale: The 'agent' is a keyword/rule script with a fake directive endpoint, autonomous quarantine without approval and simulated data; only the memory/session schema is worth borrowing, and richer equivalents exist in other repos.
